data.long_meaning: In Greek, 'Gainer' means 'one who gains' or 'one who wins'. This name was given to children who were expected to bring victory or wealth to their families. The name Gainer carries the meaning “Gainer of victory or wealth” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gainer usually hope their child will grow to embody gainer of victory or wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes perseverance and determination in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Gainer belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gainer of victory or wealth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gainer total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
